items.difficulty_reason: 13 行、模理想的不变量多项式行为与整性：(1) 由 pol-lifting 引理（I = JR）给首一多项式 P，像为 (T−b)^n；(2) 核中元素 a 是 x ∈ R^G∩JR 的像，范数分解 (T−x)^n = ∏(T−σ(x)) 模 J 由 pol-in-ideal 引理同余于 T^n；整性 + 纯不可分剩余域扩张由 universally-bijective 引理给出谱的同胚。承重全在 span 内；3 处引用（2 同章、1 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-invariants-modulo-bis (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 32602-32616

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the lifting of invariant elements modulo JR by the polynomial lifting lemma giving the monic polynomial with image (T - b)^n, the norm identity (T - x)^n = prod (T - sigma(x)) reduced modulo J by the polynomial-in-ideal lemma giving (T - a)^n = T^n, and the integrality and spectral consequences from the universally bijective lemma of the algebra chapter (source lines 32618-32625)
